displayIdentity.body: Coworkers, exchanged letters, Archippus, and Paul’s autograph. Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (about whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”), I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
